title: Decodability Is Not Controllability: Local and Anisotropic Speaker Control in Continuous-Latent TTS
abstract: arXiv:2610.29345v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High linear decodability does not entail causal controllability in continuous-latent text-to-speech (TTS). In VoxCPM2, position-matched probes and equal-norm interventions across 30 speakers and 60 directed dyads expose this separation: reference-audio states at the final residual acoustic language model layer (RALM L7) retain 0.970 probe accuracy, yet aligned edits yield 0/60 target-dominant dyads. Edits at early reference-audio positions produce the opposite pattern. At L0, pair-aligned updates increase target similarity by 0.326 and achieve target dominance in all 60 dyads, against at most 1/60 under any equal-norm direction or position control. Independent speaker encoders, retrieval against held-out speaker prototypes, and double-blind listening confirm that the shifted voice is heard as the intended target. translated_title: 可解码性并非可控性：连续潜变量TTS中的局部与各向异性说话人控制
translated_abstract: 在连续潜变量文本转语音（TTS）中，高线性可解码性并不意味着因果可控性。在 VoxCPM2 中，通过跨30名说话人和60个有向说话人配对的匹配位置探针与等范数干预揭示了这种分离：最终残差声学语言模型层（RALM L7）的参考音频状态保持0.970的探针准确率，但对齐编辑在60个配对中却产生0个目标主导结果。在参考音频早期位置的编辑则呈现相反的模式：在L0层，配对对齐更新使目标说话人相似度提升0.326，并在全部60个配对中实现目标主导，而任何等范数方向或位置控制下最多仅达到1/60。独立的说话人编码器、针对保留说话人原型的检索以及双盲听测共同证实，转换后的声音被听者感知为预期的目标说话人。在 dots.tts 中的跨架构干预进一步区分了主干杠杆作用与直接声学控制：主干编辑……
tldr: 该研究揭示连续潜变量TTS中说话人特征的高可解码性并不等于因果可控性，有效的话者音色控制依赖于在参考音频早期位置（L0层）进行干预，而非探针准确率最高的深层。
en_tdlr: Decodability of speaker identity in continuous-latent TTS does not entail causal controllability—effective speaker control requires edits at early reference-audio positions (L0 layer), not at deep layers with the highest probe accuracy.
